description: Saves a rating and feedback for a Plot Speaks story the user has just played: 1 to 5 stars, whether anything was given away too early, an optional comment about the story, optional feedback about the experience for the people who make Plot Speaks, and, for a story still being tested, the player's verdict (passed, or needs work). Needs the play id from start_story; one rating per play; stars or a verdict (or both).

comment.description: The player's comment about the story, if any, in their words

feedback.description: Feedback about the experience (the narration, the connector, what to improve), if any, in the player's words; read by the people who make Plot Speaks

spoiled.description: True if the player felt the narrator gave something away too early

stars.description: 1 to 5 (optional when a verdict is given)

verdict.description: For a story being tested: "passed" if it passed the player's test, "needs_work" if something should be improved (put what, in their words, in feedback)

wish.description: What else the player would like to play, if they said, in their words

name: rate_story
title: Rate a story
